many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Correct the one transcription omission in row 25 (the rightmost patterned cell is 5).
grid[25].append(5)
# Fill the hidden top margin and border cells.
for c in range(11,18): grid[1][c]=1; grid[2][c]=4
for r in (9,10): grid[r][1]=1; grid[r][2]=4
for r in range(11,18): grid[r][0:3]=[1,1,4]
# Propagate each remaining zero run backwards from its first known cell to the right.
cycle=[1,3,5,7,9]
for r,row in enumerate(grid):
    c=0
    while c<28:
        if row[c]!=0:
            c+=1; continue
        start=c
        while c<28 and row[c]==0: c+=1
        end=c
        if r in (1,2):
            continue
        if r in range(9,18) and start<=4:
            continue
        assert end<28 and row[end] in cycle, (r,start,end,row[end] if end<28 else None)
        idx=cycle.index(row[end])
        for x in range(end-1,start-1,-1):
            idx=(idx-1)%5
            row[x]=cycle[idx]
print([len(x) for x in grid], [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0])
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
